# ScrollAxis

`Flare.Components.ScrollAxis`

Which axis a direction filter reacts to.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Vertical` | `0` | Only vertical reversals count. |
| `Horizontal` | `1` | Only horizontal reversals count - a carousel, a horizontal timeline, a Gantt chart. |
| `Both` | `2` | A reversal on either axis counts. |
